activityOne.sourceTitle: Activity 1: Build Objects with Cubes (15 minutes)
activityOne.studentPrompt: Which is bigger? Explain or show your reasoning.
activityOne.studentTasks: Two object pairs; explain or show reasoning and define 'bigger'.
activityOne.teacherTiming: 5 minutes individual work, then 5 minutes partner work
activityOne.sourceSynthesis: Each object in each of the two source pairs occupies eight equal-size cubes; distinguish greater height from equal volume
activityOne.languageSupport: MLR2 Collect and Display: bigger, longer, wider, taller, shorter, how many, more than, less than
activityOne.existingError: Rich V2 explanatory paragraph mislabeled official activity as 'Which Is Bigger?' instead of source activity title 'Build Objects with Cubes'
activityOne.resolution: Corrected activity label and teacher launch/timing/language support only; preserved original Edulytiks eight-cube examples and rubric.
